items.title: Bill Holman interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, February 13, 1999
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] My name is Monk Rowe... [INTERVIEWEE] Thank you, Monk.

ctx.x: Bill Holman is one of the most respected arranger/composers in all of jazz. He was born in Olive, California on May 21, 1927, and took up the sax and clarinet in public school. After a brief fling with mechanical engineering, he established himself in the west coast jazz scene as a saxophonist and arranger. He performed with Charlie Barnet and Stan Kenton’s big bands and in small groups with Shorty Rogers, Conte Candoli and Shelly Manne. Bill has worked for a long list of the best artists in jazz and popular…
Bill was interviewed in Los Angeles on February 13, 1999, by Monk Rowe, Director of the Hamilton College Jazz Archive.
My name is Monk Rowe and we are filming in Los Angeles for the Hamilton College Jazz Archive. And I’m very pleased to have Bill Holman with me. Welcome.
